unverified_attempts.name: one8-baseline-plus
unverified_attempts.reason: Scorer asserted a frozen final image although continuous tracking permits updates. No verified outcome; retained as a scoring failure.

conclusion: Accuracy targets and robust fast-lap acceptance remain unachieved. A single31.65s clean lap is not a reliability result. The planning-only saved-route experiment is retired.
protocol: Changing development mechanisms; not a single frozen cohort. Only U+/U-, M+/M- and P+/P- are their respective unchanged two-start pairs. Every declared outcome is included.
scoring: Native truth only after estimator outputs are frozen. One fixed initial yaw/origin frame, no scale fit. Full-flight means include startup and failures.
controls: Public camera, public HIGHRES_IMU, timing/ACKs and own commands. P trials additionally used a prior camera-estimated route for planning only; no saved gate states initialized navigation.

drag_velocity_fit.independent_rule: Freeze before new-flight labels. Heldout overall RMS improves>=15%; no gate worsens>5%. No refit or fallback selection.
drag_velocity_fit.limits: Camera-derived velocity is a noisy regressor. Windows overlap within each gate; CV units are whole gates. Same-flight CV is development only. No raw dynamic acceleration, native fields or fused p/v enter this fit.

drag_pixel_fit.model: Shared horizontal and separate body-down quadratic drag. Freeze thrust, gyro integration, mount, scale and epoch means. Per-gate initial velocity and gate xyz/yaw are nuisance variables.
drag_pixel_fit.prediction: Fit held-gate initial velocity and geometry using first0.5s of pixels only; score every later image. Whole gates are CV units.
drag_pixel_fit.uncertainty: Fixed1px independent corner floor plus shared rotational image timing uncertainty10ms. Robust softL1 scale2; neither is fitted to native labels.
drag_pixel_fit.validation_rule: New independent flight: average future-pixel RMS improves>=15%; no gate worsens>5%. No refit or fallback selection.

drag_partial_validation.reason: Required third public sequence missing. Partial predictions are diagnostic only; no model installation.

scale_identifiability.interpretation: Identifiability audit only. Near-hover drag correction is frozen, public9.81m/s2 gravity is the independent metric term. No native labels or model installation. Bootstrap is model-conditional, not a calibrated physical interval.

ideal_visibility_audit.assumptions: Reference-only audit: public learned complete map available for comparison, ideal tracking/attitude, fixed public dynamics. The complete future map is never supplied to the live controller. Occlusion, line fit, covariance and delayed future discovery are not modeled.

drag_transfer.reason: Neither independent stream supplied all3 required gate sequences under the frozen image checks. No drag change was installed.

background.tracks: Available through the gate3 outage: median166 mature tracks across20/32cells.
background.translation_axis: 0/17 robust axes; bootstrap spreads16-27deg and large time sensitivity. No update installed.
background.vertical: 0/134 level and0/78 timed compressed-frame fits; originalJPEG test0/23. No background gravity update installed.
background.inputs: Public pixels/gyro only; original stream8,650,732bytes,110frames,3,143unique plus3,143byte-identical duplicate datagrams.
